Name: Gold Clock to Seasonal Tree
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
The gold clock is now a seasonal tree. Spring is yellow. Summer is pink. Fall is orange and winter blue. 

[b]Insulation[/b]
1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
2. Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract [b]Gold Clock to Seasonal Tree[/b] into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
4. Launch Stardew Valley and enjoy.

Farmhouse mod is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31568]Raccoon Style Farmhouse [/url]
